title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
hook_text: A Meta AI director is launching a startup.
script:
Meta AI director Rohit Patel is leaving his role after eight years.
He spent those eight years building expertise in reinforcement learning and AI evaluations.
His new startup is called Ndoc.
The company aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.
Ndoc also plans to compete directly with Google Workspace.
Would you replace your office software with this new startup tool?
